title: Force a specific file to be written to disk
summary: Use the `sync` command with a file path to ensure that changes to that specific file are immediately saved to the physical disk, rather than waiting for the system to do it later.

steps.explain: Run sync followed by the path to the file you want to force-write to the disk.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The full path to the file you want to sync.
